{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the first few rows of revenue to confirm format
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique revenue values with commas:")
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10 unique values

# Check if there are any non-numeric characters
print("\nNon-numeric revenue entries:")
non_numeric = sales[~sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').str.isnumeric()]['revenue'].unique()
print(non_numeric)"}
